subject: Reminder: Upcoming Team Meeting
body: Dear Team, Just a friendly reminder that we have our monthly team meeting scheduled for this Friday at 10:00 AM. The meeting will cover updates on ongoing projects, upcoming deadlines, and any team concerns. Please make sure to come prepared with your project updates and any relevant materials. Let me know if you have any questions or need further information. Looking forward to seeing you all there! Best regards, [Your Name]
